key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 operating cash flow $14.747B minus capital spending $8.527B, divided by 3.528B weighted-average diluted shares (10-K FY2025)
Energy storage ramp, auto volume stable, no robotaxi in base cash flow

open_questions: [ ] Read full 10-K/A narrative on robotaxi and capex guidance
thesis: Tesla designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and solar products. **[Fact]** FY2025 consolidated revenue was approximately **$94.8 billion**, net income **$3.8 billion**, and operating cash flow **$14.7 billion** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260129_rpt20251231_acc0001628280_26_003952.htm`). **[Fact]** Capital spending was **$8.5 billion**, implying free cash flow near **$6.2 billion** or about **$1.76 per diluted share** on **3.53 billion** weighted-average diluted shares. **[Fact]** Research and development expense was **$6.4 billion** in FY2025. **[Fact]** The company reports two operating segments: **Automotive** and **Energy Generation and Storage** (10-K segment note). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 revenue was **$22.4 billion** with net income **$477 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260423_rpt20260331_acc0001628280_26_026673.htm`).
why_market_wrong: The stock may price in robotaxi, Full Self-Driving subscription scale, or Optimus optionality that filings do not yet support as owner cash. **[Inference]** At roughly **$350** per share, the market may capitalize autonomy narratives while FY2025 diluted earnings per share was only **$1.08** and automotive margins face competition. **[Inference]** Energy storage is growing faster than auto but remains small relative to consolidated revenue; the market may overweight option value in the auto segment. **[Inference]** Heavy capital spending for AI training and new models may compress near-term free cash flow below the FY2025 normalized path.
